messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH — alert fired: gateway.http.5xx_rate (inference-gateway-prod-us-west) — threshold breached: 1m window > 5%
incident-bot: Pager: @sre-oncall — incident id: PDINC-874129 — link: https://pagerduty.example/PDINC-874129
sre-oncall: ACK — I'm on it, looking at dashboards now
matt: seeing a sharp jump in 502/504 from the frontend edge in us-west in the last 60s. latency up too.
ashwin: got logs pulled, looks like nginx upstream "502 bad gateway" to backend pool. correlation with a config push ~2m ago?
sre-oncall: @matt @ashwin show me the last deploys to ingress in us-west pls
matt: here — deploybot: "deploy ingress-proxy: nginx-1.18.3 -> nginx-1.18.4" at 4567890055
ashwin: copying relevant tail from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:15:23Z proxy us-west proxy-01 upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream
2026-03-15T02:15:24Z proxy us-west proxy-02 502 "bad gateway" upstream: 10.0.5.12:8080
2026-03-15T02:15:25Z proxy us-west proxy-01 504 "gateway timeout" backend read timed out
```
sre-oncall: ok. @ashwin can you try rolling back the canary/proxy nodes to previous revision? if that reduces 5xx we can promote rollback to all zones.
ashwin: doing quick rollback on canary set now — running:
```
kubectl -n ingress rollout undo deployment/proxy-canary --to-revision=3
kubectl -n ingress get pods -l app=proxy-canary -w
```
ashwin: rollback issued, pods restarting (2/3)
katie-support: ping from support — customer reports about 10% of requests failing for embeddings endpoints in us-west, some retries visible. customers affected: internal analytics team + a handful of paying customers. escalating to CS lead.
oliver: checking autoscale/target groups — backend pool instance count steady. nothing obvious on infra CPU. might be connection exhaustion on proxy -> backend sockets.
matt: can we temporarily route traffic away from proxy-canary (weight 10%) to stable?
sre-oncall: yes — switching routing to stable 100% for us-west via traffic-split. doing now.
incident-bot: traffic shift executed: proxy-canary weight -> 0%, stable -> 100% (api: /routing/weights)
matt: immediate drop in 502 rate on dashboard — looks like baseline returning. nice.
sre-oncall: good. monitor for 5m. leaving PD incident open until postmortem.
katie-support: contacting affected customers with a quick note: "We observed elevated 5xx errors in us-west starting at ~02:15 UTC. We've routed traffic away from a canary proxy and errors are returning to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."
ashwin: will open a follow-up runbook/PR to revert the faulty nginx change and add a canary healthcheck to prevent this type of propagation.
matt: note for postmortem: nginx upstream_connect_timeout decreased in that patch, may have made proxy more sensitive to backend latency spikes.
sre-oncall: assigning follow-up to infra: @ashwin + @matt — please include timeline and config diff in postmortem. tagging severity: P2 (customer impact but mitigated).
pagerduty-bot: PDINC-874129 status: acknowledged by sre-oncall at 4567890128 — escalation suppressed.
incident-bot: handoff: oncall will keep monitoring for 30m. if error-rate > 1% again, pager will re-trigger.
sre-oncall: final check — metrics look stable for 3m, error-rate back to 0.7% 1m window. I'm going offline to prep the postmortem doc.
katie-support: thanks team — support will follow up with customers and include a note when the postmortem is available. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: closing Slack thread summary: mitigated by traffic split rollback and canary undo; follow-up: config patch revert + improved canary healthchecks + postmortem.
